reference: LUMEN CUBE - FICTIONAL DISPLAY KIT
Each display capsule contains 12 mg of imaginary sparkle.

Keep the display capsule in its silver sleeve.
The cardboard cradle protects the fictional display during storage.
The label describes a bright decorative object.
